Palakkad Fort, also known as Tipu's Fort, is a prominent historical landmark located in the heart of Palakkad town. Built in 1766 by Hyder Ali of Mysore, this well-preserved granite fortress narrates tales of Mysore invasions and the arrival of the British in the region. 

Inside the fort grounds, visitors can explore the ramparts, a surrounding moat, expansive green grounds, and a significant Hanuman temple. It stands as a symbol of the district's rich heritage and strategic importance along the Palakkad Gap.
